phrases.गोचर में हर ग्रह जन्म-चंद्र राशि से कुछ: In transit each planet is held favourable in certain houses from the natal Moon sign. We combine this with the planet's ashtakavarga bindus in that sign (4 or more = supportive). 'Mixed' means the two signals disagree. Vedha is applied: a favourable house's result is held to be blocked when another planet sits at its vedha point (Sun-Saturn and Moon-Mercury do not obstruct each other); this is an indication, not a prediction.
